verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a public API for searching 138M+ papers, generating research reports, and running full systematic reviews (search strategy, screening, extraction, reporting), and all API functionality is also exposed through an MCP server. However, the documented API scope covers only a subset of the UI. Nothing shows API access to the Research Agent sessions, skills, projects, collaboration, alerts, Library/collections, Zotero/RIS import, or chat-with-papers, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for Research Agent/skills/projects, library and collection management, alerts, imports and exports, and chat, plus a published API reference/spec and independent confirmation of parity.
